annotations.title: Get your embeddable MCP Readiness status badge

description: Get your embeddable 'SaSame MCP Readiness' status badge — it renders the LATEST grade SaSame has observed for an MCP server against the public 10-criterion standard (offered for A/B grades). Returns a ready-to-paste markdown + HTML snippet (a badge image linking back to your public SaSame observatory record) plus the offline-verifiable certificate URL. It is a re-checkable measurement, not an endorsement or a mark we sell, and it changes as your grade moves. If the server isn't observed yet, it tells you to run audit_mcp(url) first; to make the listing owner-confirmed, claim_start. Free, read-only, no signup.

url.description: The MCP server endpoint URL to get a badge for (ideally your own)

name: get_badge
